newsitem.title: UK: IPE NATURAL GAS EASES LOWER, SEPT ENDS AT 9 PENCE.
newsitem.headline: IPE NATURAL GAS EASES LOWER, SEPT ENDS AT 9 PENCE.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures headed lower on Tuesday with September settling at nine pence a therm.
One major spot market trader was a heavy seller on the September contract.
"They were really selling it down. It didn't quite crack nine pence but it almost did," said one trader.
The front balance of month contract was untraded on Tuesday and talked in a fairly wide range of 8.80/9.30 pence.
Further out on the forward curve, all months from October to February were traded, shedding between 0.060 pence and 0.220 pence.
